What does HTML stand for?
HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language.
What does CSS stand for?

What does URL stand for?
URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator. It is a string of characters used to specify how to locate and retrieve a resource on the web.
What does JSON stand for?
JSON stands for JavaScript Object Notation. It is a lightweight data-interchange format that is easy for humans to read and write and easy for machines to parse and generate.
What does SSH stand for?
SSH stands for Secure Shell. It is a cryptographic protocol for secure network connections and remote command-line logins.
What does DNS stand for?
DNS stands for Domain Name System. It is a hierarchical and distributed system that translates domain names (names) into IP addresses, which are used by devices to communicate over the Internet.
